verdicts.reason: Ground One, para 79-95: evident partiality under 10(a)(2) from undisclosed son-at-claimant's-counsel relationship.
Paras 38, 40, 44, 88: August 22, 2023 PAS Disclosure Statement denied any Ridgeline relationship and never disclosed son.
Para 80 cites Commonwealth Coatings, 393 U.S. 145 (1968), 'impression of possible bias'; also Merit and Sphere Drake.
Para 5: 'Together they describe an arbitration ... denied both a neutral decision-maker and a fair opportunity'; paras 92, 150.
Para 86 invokes IBA Guidelines Red List for family member at counsel's firm, plus PAS Rule 12(a).
